content.title: Gratefulness Grab Bag
content.summary: Gratefulness Grab Bag coordinated through declared pool or group steps.
content.setup: Invite participants in the desired turn order.
content.participant: Follow the current step; claims and acknowledgments are recorded by the app.
content.completion: The app finishes after the last declared step.
content.access: Pooled authorship metadata is withheld; group responses use the membership recorded for their round.
